About the AWP | Oni Taiji

High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils. A predator is a predator, no matter the environment The AWP | Oni Taiji is a Covert-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Oni Taiji finish on the AWP. With a Covert rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.26% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The AWP | Oni Taiji can be unboxed from the Operation Hydra Case. It belongs to the Operation Hydra Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.50. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The AWP | Oni Taiji (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $1,001.63, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $350.13 (Field-Tested) to $1,001.63 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The AWP | Oni Taiji has a community rating of 4.3 out of 5 based on 28,816 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among AWP skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the AWP | Oni Taiji?

Factory New (FN) AWP | Oni Taiji skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Oni Taiji pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Why is the AWP | Oni Taiji so expensive?

The AWP | Oni Taiji commands premium prices due to several factors: It belongs to the The Operation Hydra Collection and can be unboxed from the Operation Hydra Case. The Oni Taiji finish is particularly sought-after for its distinctive appearance, and supply is inherently limited while demand remains high from collectors and players.

What is the float value range for the AWP | Oni Taiji?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.50, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Can I use the AWP | Oni Taiji in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the AWP | Oni Taiji are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.
